policies.on-error:
<set-variable name="ccofUsageRetryAfter" value="@(Convert.ToString(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ccofRetryAfter", "%%USAGE_PERIOD%%")))" />
    
      
      
        application/json
      
      
        no-store
      
      
        @((string)context.Variables["ccofUsageRetryAfter"])
      
      
        @(context.RequestId.ToString())
      
      @{
          var status = (int)context.Variables["ccofUsageErrorStatus"];
          var type = status == 401 ? "authentication_error" : status == 429 ? "rate_limit_error" : "api_error";
          var message = status == 401 ? "Sign in to the gateway again (ccof-token login), then retry."
              : status == 429 ? "Usage was asked for too often. Wait for the time in the Retry-After header."
              : "The gateway hit an unexpected error reading usage. Retry; if this continues, tell your platform team.";
          return new JObject(new JProperty("type", "error"), new JProperty("error", new JObject(new JProperty("type", type), new JProperty("message", message + " Request id: " + context.RequestId.ToString() + ".")))).ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
      }
